title: dactylorhiza serotina
intro: Dactylorhiza serotina, commonly known as Autumn Lady's Tresses, is a species of orchid native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza serotina include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
